# InfiniGen: Efficient Generative Inference of Large Language Models with Dynamic KV Cache Management

## Abstract

InfiniGen is a KV cache management framework that improves performance and accuracy in long-text generation by pre-fetching essential KV cache entries in offloading-based LLM serving systems.

Serving LLM inference for generating long contents, however, poses a challenge due to the enormous memory footprint of the transient state, known as the key-value (KV) cache, which scales with the sequence length and batch size. In this paper, we present InfiniGen, a novel KV cache management framework tailored for long-text generation, which synergistically works [...] overhead from the host memory in offloading-based LLM serving systems. Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive performance across various natural language processing tasks. Serving LLM inference for generating long contents, however, poses a challenge due to the enormous memory footprint of the transient state, known as the key-value (KV) cache, which scales with the sequence length and batch size. In this paper, we present InfiniGen, a novel KV cache management framework tailored for long-text generation, which synergistically works [...] overhead from the host memory in offloading-based LLM serving systems. Our evaluation on several representative LLMs shows that InfiniGen improves the overall performance of a modern offloading-based system by up to 3.00x compared to prior KV cache management methods while offering substantially better model accuracy. [...] Speedup over FlexGen. (a) Across sequence lengths 512 to 2,048, InfiniGen's bars rise, while the baselines rise less and then saturate. (b) InfiniGen is ahead at the three tested model sizes: 6.7B, 13B, and 30B.

InfiniGen leaves old tokens available in CPU memory and fetches a changing subset when each next layer needs it. The evidence covers particular models, tasks, and an offloading system, not every LLM-serving workload.

results.content:
Generating long content with LLMs presents a challenge due to the substantial memory requirements of the transient state, known as the key-value (KV) cache, which scales with sequence length and batch size. This blog reviews InfiniGen, a novel KV cache management framework designed specifically for long-text generation, which integrates seamlessly with modern offloading-based inference systems, which leverage larger CPU memory. InfiniGen leverages a key insight: only a few essential tokens are [...] tokens are necessary to compute the attention layers of Transformers in subsequent steps. By speculating on these critical tokens using the inputs of the current layer and part of the query weight and key cache of the next layer, InfiniGen enables prefetching of only the essential KV cache entries, thus reducing fetch overhead from host CPU memory in offloading-based LLM systems.
